checks.name: RQ-009 | CRM | type de personne normalisé autorisé
checks.definition:
checks for client:
  - failed rows:
      name: RQ-009 | CRM | type de personne normalisé autorisé
      fail query: |
        SELECT client_id
        FROM client
        WHERE type_personne IS NULL OR CASE LOWER(TRIM(type_personne))
                WHEN 'prosp.' THEN 'prospect'

checks.name: RQ-003 | CRM | taux de telephones renseignes
checks.definition:
checks for client:
  - rq003_taux_telephone:
      name: RQ-003 | CRM | taux de telephones renseignes
      rq003_taux_telephone query: |
        SELECT 100.0 * SUM(
                 CASE WHEN telephone IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(telephone) <> '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
               ) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS taux
        FROM client
        WHERE LOWER(TRIM(type_personne)) = 'souscripteur'
      warn: when < 98

checks.name: RQ-018 | CRM | ecart nul entre les trois directions
checks.definition:
checks for contrat:
  - rq018_ecart_directions:
      name: RQ-018 | CRM | ecart nul entre les trois directions
      rq018_ecart_directions query: |
        SELECT MAX(nb_actifs) - MIN(nb_actifs) AS ecart
        FROM (
          SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.souscripteur_id) AS nb_actifs
          FROM contrat c
          WHERE c.date_debut <= '${REFERENCE_DATE}'
            AND c.date_fin >= '${REFERENCE_DATE}'
            AND c.date_derniere_cotisation >= DATE_SUB('${REFERENCE_DATE}', INTERVAL 3 MONTH)
          UNION ALL
          SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.souscripteur_id)
          FROM contrat c
          WHERE c.date_debut <= '${REFERENCE_DATE}'
            AND c.date_fin >= '${REFERENCE_DATE}'
            AND c.date_derniere_cotisation >= DATE_SUB('${REFERENCE_DATE}', INTERVAL 3 MONTH)
          UNION ALL
          SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.souscripteur_id)
          FROM contrat c
          WHERE c.date_debut <= '${REFERENCE_DATE}'
            AND c.date_fin >= '${REFERENCE_DATE}'
            AND c.date_derniere_cotisation >= DATE_SUB('${REFERENCE_DATE}', INTERVAL 3 MONTH)
        ) directions
      fail: when > 0
